title: The WP2LEADS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based SQL Injection via the ‘order’ parameter in all versions…
description: The WP2LEADS WordPress plugin versions up to and including 3.5.6 contain a time-based SQL Injection vulnerability via the 'order' parameter. This flaw allows authenticated users with Subscriber-level access or higher to inject additional SQL queries due to insufficient escaping and lack of proper query preparation. Exploitation can lead to unauthorized extraction of sensitive database information.
